Here to help you feed & train your dog, better based on what I've learned from experts

My favorite pet finds: https://www.rachelfusaro.com/shop
Dog Food List: https://www.rachelfusaro.com/dogfood

Facebook: www.facebook.com/rachelfusaro
Instagram: www.instagram.com/rachelfusaro

About me: After earning my Bachelor’s degree in Nutrition Science, I spent +10 years training rescue foster dogs and working in the pet food industry where I was surrounded by thought leaders in pet health (ie. Veterinarians, Canine Nutritionists, professional dog trainers, published authors…). I share what I've learned from them.

Disclaimer: none of my content is intended to treat, prescribe, diagnose, advise, cure or recommend. Please consult a professional trainer and veterinarian for any health, medical or behavior needs. I am not a veterinarian or professionally trained dog trainer. Content I share is based on my personal experiences. Some links/content contain affiliate or sponsored content and links.
